figurative_meaning_en: Lakshmi (goddess of wealth and prosperity), Saraswati (goddess of knowledge and wisdom)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে শ্রী প্রবেশ করেছে, এখন সবকিছু সফল হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Shri has entered his life, now everything is going successfully.
If Shri is in studies, success will surely come.
history: Derived from ancient Hindu scriptures where Shri refers to divine grace personified as Lakshmi and Saraswati in Vedic and Puranic texts.
note: শ্রী often used as an honorific prefix in names, symbolizing auspicious invocation of these deities.
